title: Zombie in Graffiti Hallway
description: A zombie in a tattered yellow jacket stumbles through a derelict hallway covered in peeling green paint and colorful graffiti. The walls feature cartoonish monster faces with bulging eyes and long tongues, while a human skeleton lies on the floor beside an overturned bucket and scattered debris under fluorescent lighting.
